name: Ribeye with Spicy Cucumber-Avocado Salad & Orange Soy Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
3 jalapeño peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ avocados
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice oranges into a large bowl. Add oil, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and add to the bowl.  (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Trim and slice radishes into thin rounds. Add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and medium dice. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with steak. Enjoy!
